description: Official baseline bytes/schema and original event IDs have not been verified; ccode 483 remains provisional.
required_followup: Coordinator checks the official baseline before compatibility or export; do not infer official acceptance from this provisional dossier.

description: Feb 6 N’Djamena report gives one group of 31+ and additional unquantified district groups; the site/event aggregate remains below or above the 50 threshold unknown.
required_followup: Find attendance evidence for each site and apply the original event/site boundary rule; do not sum districts without evidence.

description: Feb 6 Doba attendance is not reported; about twenty arrests cannot stand in for the crowd size.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous attendance estimate for the Doba gathering.

description: Moundou has a report of approximately thirty protest-rights convictions in the Feb 6 chronology, but the opened passages do not describe an underlying assembly or fix its date.
required_followup: Verify whether a public assembly occurred in Moundou, its date/site, and its relationship to the Feb 6 call.

description: Feb 13 N’Djamena march has no turnout estimate in the opened retrospective account; several neighborhoods do not prove an aggregate of at least 50.
required_followup: Find an eligible direct account with event/site attendance and preserve RFI-copy lineage.

description: Feb 15 MNCT march has no turnout estimate; thirty arrests and beatings of dozens are not turnout. The direct HRW source cited by TLP is covered by an explicit publisher-wide hold.
required_followup: Seek an eligible source independent of the held HRW body for attendance and event details; do not request copies or alternate HRW URLs.

description: The Feb 15 sit-in announcement names the French embassy and companies, but this first pass found no report of execution.
required_followup: Keep announcement and occurrence distinct; only reinstate as a candidate if a source reports an actual gathering.

description: For all candidates, unreported accommodation, deliberate ignoring, shootings and killings remain unknown; the report does not establish a precise physical end for any rally.
required_followup: Only replace unknowns with event-specific evidence; do not infer absent response or physical closure from publication dates, arrest counts or campaign continuation.

description: The general public-sector strike began in January and union suspension is reported on Feb 6; residual school absences mean formal suspension may not mark the physical end.
required_followup: Compare the continuation with Chad January and distinguish Jan-start labor action, Feb suspension, and any separate public assembly.

description: French regional searches covered Moundou, Doba, Sarh and Abéché. This pass has direct reported material for N’Djamena and Doba plus an ambiguous Moundou lead; Sarh and Abéché coverage is unresolved. No absence is inferred.
required_followup: Look for local coverage and site-level attendance in provinces, including Sarh and Abéché, if a permitted source is found.

description: Teacher, student, health-worker and public-worker searches found the January-start strike continuation but no independently established February sector assembly. Out-of-month hits appeared in search results.
required_followup: Review sector-specific February sources if available; do not turn strikes, absenteeism or search hits from other years into public assemblies.

description: Searches used French and Arabic, including Arabic for protests and labor. No speaker-reviewed Chadian Arabic transliteration or minority-language source coverage (for example Sara or Kanembu) was established.
required_followup: If local-language sources become available, use a qualified reader and preserve original text/provenance; absence from French/Arabic open web is not absence of action.

description: The retrospective TLP report cites Amnesty for Feb 6, RFI for Feb 13 and HRW for Feb 15. Mosaïque’s Feb 13 result reproduces RFI; HRW direct and copies remain held. These are not independent source counts.
required_followup: Retain source-level lineage and do not count a cited report and its reprint as independent corroboration.

description: Source access limits affected review: Le Pays and Ialtchad exact opens returned cache misses; TV5 exact URL returned 403; HRW has an explicit publisher-wide hold; the exact BeInChad URL has a prior 406. Only saved receipts/manual reviews authorize no body access, and no retry/copy was made.
required_followup: Preserve denials/holds, and pursue only genuinely distinct permitted sources after a fresh exact-URL receipt and full publisher/origin review.

description: The opposition campaign continues beyond February, but later marches are separate dates and the physical end of February actions is not established. No March action is assigned to this month.
required_followup: Review March in its own month and compare campaign continuity without extending February event end dates.
